note: Deterministic motion recipes for the 824x820 slot. A recipe is a pure function of time; it never changes data, text or color, and returns the static component once its duration has elapsed.

recipes.name: clip
recipes.label: Left-to-right clip reveal
recipes.purpose: The baseline reveal; reads as a curtain.
recipes.use_when: Tables, lists, timelines that read left to right.

recipes.name: rise
recipes.label: Elements rise in order
recipes.purpose: Each element lifts into place in drawing order.
recipes.not_when: Dense charts with hundreds of elements.

recipes.name: stagger
recipes.label: Fade in, one element after another
recipes.purpose: Quiet sequential fade with no movement.
recipes.not_when: When the reveal itself should carry meaning.

recipes.name: draw-on
recipes.label: Strokes draw first, then fills and text
recipes.purpose: Connectors and axes appear before the content they organize.

recipes.name: scale-settle
recipes.label: Whole graphic settles from a slight zoom
recipes.purpose: One fast entrance for the whole slot.

recipes.name: slide-in
recipes.label: Slides in from the left
recipes.purpose: Lateral entrance for the whole slot.
recipes.use_when: Alternating with wipe or clip across a batch.
recipes.not_when: Compositions anchored to the left edge.

recipes.name: focus
recipes.label: Everything appears, then the rest dims
recipes.purpose: Shows the whole first, then draws the eye to the highlighted element.
recipes.use_when: Components with a highlight or active state.

recipes.name: accent-pulse
recipes.label: Fast clip reveal, then the accent elements pulse once
recipes.purpose: A one-second reveal, then one deterministic pulse on the accent-colored elements.
recipes.use_when: Calling out the accent series or value.
recipes.not_when: Components where the accent carries no meaning.
